migration.name: 20261016100000_AddOrderShippingGroups
constraints: FK checkout_id -> order.checkouts(checkout_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK shipping_group_id -> order_shipping_groups(shipping_group_id) ON DELETE CASCADE on lines
FK order_line_id -> order.order_lines(line_id) ON DELETE CASCADE (Order-owned)
PK (shipping_group_id, order_line_id) and UNIQUE(order_line_id) on lines -> a line belongs to exactly one group

contractsAdded: OrderShippingGroupPlan (draft -> order conversion carrier, money/identity/promise from the draft)
invariants: group seller order == order line seller order; group.CheckoutId == checkout; wrong seller aborts with order.shipping.group.seller_mismatch
full bijective coverage: every order line in exactly one group (…line.missing / …line.duplicate)
membership resolved from the authoritative cart-line -> order-line map captured while the order lines were created (…cart_line.mapping_missing) — never inferred positionally
origin always null in v1; a declared origin fails closed with …origin.unverified (BLOCKED_ORIGIN_AUTHORITY recorded, nothing forged)
seller order merchandise totals unchanged; shipping payable = sum of committed group charges, computed exactly once
genuine multi-group order no longer projects one arbitrary method into checkouts.shipping_method_code/label (cleared instead)
idempotency: existing checkout by key/cart short-circuits before persistence, so retries cannot add groups or charges
transactionBoundary: Groups are materialized inside the existing TransactionScope(ReadCommitted) in CheckoutProcessManager.SubmitAsync, in ICheckoutSubmitHost.PersistCheckoutAsync before SaveChangesAsync; all invariant checks throw ContractOperationException before any row is added.
guardChange: StorefrontShippingService.CommitAsync no longer blocks >1 groups (order conversion now persists them); ProjectPaymentDraftAsync keeps EnsureLegacySingleGroup because the unchanged Payment module still expects one StoreShipping allocation.

tests.reruns: 1 focused run, then 1 full Order.Tests run; no reruns after a fix were needed
tests.notExecuted: No runtime DB migration/EF validation (no isolated disposable Postgres inside the box; Order.Tests does not reference Order.Infrastructure) and no browser acceptance.

unprovenClaims: Migration/EF model was not executed against a real database; DDL correctness is static-review only.
M1's two-phase draft group replacement remains non-atomic by design; M2 reads the persisted draft after the commit-time revalidation, so a phase-2 failure there fails closed before order conversion.
Draft group identity is regenerated on each draft re-save (M1 planner factory); the id carried into the order is the last persisted draft id.
Per-seller shipping method eligibility remains cart-wide (no authoritative per-seller service).
Payment allocation for >1 group is out of scope; the payment path stays fail-closed.
nonInterference: No frontend/CSS/theme/template/config edit; no shared :5088/:3000 or tooba_alpha mutation; no process start/stop/kill; no DDL/DML; no seed or scratch DB; no feature flag.
rollback: Revert commit c136897f4d1a95022221c331d2cb6e2764188cb8; migration Down drops both new tables. No runtime artifact or shared state created.
firstRemainingBlocker: Payment/Settlement owner must accept multiple StoreShipping allocations (or the payment-draft boundary stays fail-closed for >1 group); per-seller method eligibility and fulfilment origin authority remain open.
